entities.name: Uu Relay RLC channel release procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by L2 U2N Relay UE to release RLC entities and logical channels for specified Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID values.

entities.name: Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID
entities.description: Identifier for Uu relay RLC channels used to specify which channels should be released.

entities.name: uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList
entities.description: List containing Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID values that should be released from the current configuration.

entities.name: RLC entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity that handles segmentation and reassembly of data packets.

entities.name: Logical channel
entities.description: Logical communication channel corresponding to an RLC entity.

entities.name: In current configuration within same cell group
entities.description: Condition that the Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID value must be part of the current configuration within the same cell group for release to occur.

relations.description: The procedure uses the uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList to determine which channels to release.
The release list contains Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID values.
Release only occurs for Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID values that are part of the current configuration within the same cell group.
The procedure results in the release of RLC entities as specified in TS 38.322.
The procedure results in the release of corresponding logical channels.
